# Karibu Congo

> Karibu Congo is a travel guide and comparison site for trips to Congo and the wider African continent, run by Samori Ltd in London. It publishes destination and hotel guides and links to booking partners for flights, hotels, car rental, tours and attractions, and travel eSIMs. Some links are affiliate links; the site may earn a commission if you book through them, at no extra cost to you. Bookings are completed with the provider, not on this site.

## Start here

- [Karibu Congo | Travel Guides and Deals for Congo and Africa](https://www.karibucongo.com/): Compare flights, hotels, car rental and eSIMs for trips to Congo and across Africa, with practical destination guides. Some links earn us a commission.
- [Discover Congo: Destinations, Cities & Places](https://www.karibucongo.com/discover-congo/): Guides to Congo's cities, parks and coast: Kinshasa, Brazzaville, Lubumbashi, Pointe-Noire, Muanda, Conkouati-Douli and Odzala-Kokoua. Hotels, day trips and flights.
- [Destinations](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/): Flights, neighborhoods, things to do, and everything else you need to plan a trip — one guide per destination.

## Congo destination guides

- [Kinshasa Destination Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/kinshasa/): Kinshasa travel guide: where to stay, what to see, and how to get around. Rumba, river life, and the pulse of Central Africa's biggest city.
- [Brazzaville Destination Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/brazzaville/): Brazzaville travel guide: where to stay, what to see and how to get around, from riverside terraces and Basilique Sainte-Anne to Lesio-Louna gorilla day trips.
- [Pointe-Noire Destination Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/pointe-noire/): Pointe-Noire travel guide: where to stay, where to eat, what to see, and how to get there by air or from Brazzaville.
- [Lubumbashi Destination Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/lubumbashi/): Lubumbashi travel guide: where to stay, where to eat, what to see, and how to get there by air or by road from southern Africa.
- [Muanda Destination Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/muanda/): A Muanda travel guide: Atlantic beaches, the Mangroves National Park, sea turtles, where to stay and eat, and how to get there from Kinshasa.
- [Kundelungu National Park Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/kundelungu-national-park/): Kundelungu National Park travel guide: Kiubo, Masasa, Lutshipuka and Lofoi waterfalls, wildlife, camping and how to get there from Lubumbashi.
- [Conkouati-Douli National Park Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/discover-congo/conkouati/): Conkouati-Douli National Park, Republic of Congo: gorillas, forest elephants, chimpanzee islands, humpback whales and how to get there from Pointe-Noire.
- [Odzala-Kokoua National Park Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/discover-congo/odzala-kokoua/): Odzala-Kokoua National Park, Republic of Congo: western lowland gorillas, forest elephants, forest clearings called bais, camps and how to get there from Brazzaville.
- [Garamba National Park Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/discover-congo/garamba/): Garamba National Park, DR Congo: elephants, Congo's only giraffes, returning white rhinos, lions and hippos on a UNESCO World Heritage savanna in Haut-Uélé.
- [Lola ya Bonobo Sanctuary Guide, Kinshasa](https://www.karibucongo.com/discover-congo/lola-ya-bonobo/): Lola ya Bonobo, the world's only sanctuary for orphaned bonobos, 30 km from Kinshasa. How rescue works, why bonobos are endangered, how to visit.
- [Bombo-Lumene National Park Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/discover-congo/bombo-lumene/): Bombo-Lumene National Park on the Batéké Plateau, 130 km from Kinshasa: savanna, gallery forest, hiking, swimming and how to plan a visit.
- [Zongo Falls Day Trip from Kinshasa: Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/discover-congo/zongo-falls/): Zongo Falls is a 65 m waterfall on the Inkisi River, 130 km from Kinshasa. How to get there, when to go, what to do, and where to eat and stay.

## International destination guides

- [Kuala Lumpur Travel Guide — Skyline, Street Food & Shopping](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/kuala-lumpur/): Plan your Kuala Lumpur trip: where to stay near the Petronas Towers, the best night markets and street food, and a simple 4-day route around the city.
- [Los Angeles Destination Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/los-angeles/): Los Angeles travel guide: where to stay, what to see and where to eat, from Hollywood, Griffith Observatory and the Getty to hotels in Beverly Hills.
- [Marrakech Travel Guide — Palaces, Souks & Sunsets](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/marrakech/): Plan a trip to Marrakech: where to stay, Bahia Palace, Jardin Majorelle, Jemaa el-Fnaa, rooftop dining, getting there via Menara Airport and a 4-day route.
- [Mauritius Travel Guide — Beaches, Waterfalls & Le Morne](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/mauritius/): Plan a trip to Mauritius: where to stay on each coast, the best beaches, Chamarel’s coloured earths and waterfalls, and a sample itinerary.
- [Zanzibar Travel Guide — Beaches, Stone Town & Islands](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/zanzibar/): Zanzibar travel guide: Stone Town, Nungwi, Kendwa and Paje beaches, where to stay, boat trips, best time to go and how to fly in via Dubai, Doha or Nairobi.
- [New York Travel Guide — Skyline, Museums & Broadway](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/new-york/): Plan your New York trip: where to stay in Midtown, the sights worth the line, Central Park, Broadway, and how to get in and out of JFK without the stress.
- [Paris Travel Guide — Icons, Neighborhoods & Day Trips](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/paris/): Everything you need to plan a Paris trip — where to stay, what to see, day trips to Versailles, and a simple route to follow.
- [Rome Travel Guide — Ruins, Piazzas & Pasta](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/rome/): Plan a trip to Rome: where to stay, the Vatican, Colosseum and Trevi Fountain, rooftop dining, getting there via Fiumicino and a simple 4-day route.
- [Seychelles Travel Guide — Beaches, Rainforest & Islands](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/seychelles/): Everything you need to plan a trip to Seychelles: Anse Lazio, Anse Source d'Argent, Vallée de Mai, where to stay, and a sample itinerary.
- [Singapore Travel Guide — Gardens, Hawkers & the Bay](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/singapore/): Everything you need to plan a trip to Singapore: Marina Bay Sands, Gardens by the Bay, hawker centres, the southern islands, and a sample itinerary.
- [Tokyo Destination Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/tokyo/): Tokyo travel guide: where to stay, what to see, and where to eat. Senso-ji, Shibuya, Ginza, Shinjuku and the best gardens and hotels.
- [Johannesburg Travel Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/johannesburg/): Everything you need to plan a trip to Johannesburg: the Apartheid Museum, Soweto, Sandton, safari parks on the city’s doorstep, and a sample itinerary.
- [Cairo Travel Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/cairo/): Everything you need to plan a trip to Cairo: the Pyramids of Giza, the Grand Egyptian Museum, the Citadel, where to stay, and a sample itinerary.
- [Barcelona Travel Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/barcelona/): Everything you need to plan a trip to Barcelona: Gaudí's Sagrada Família, the Gothic Quarter, La Boqueria, where to stay, and a sample itinerary.
- [Maldives Travel Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/maldives/): Everything you need to plan a trip to the Maldives: snorkelling, sandbanks, where to stay, how to get to the islands, and a sample itinerary.
- [Abidjan Travel Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/abidjan/): Everything you need to plan a trip to Abidjan: the Plateau skyline, Grand-Bassam beach, Banco National Park, great food, and a sample 4-day itinerary.
- [Abuja Travel Guide](https://www.karibucongo.com/destinations/abuja/): Everything you need to plan a trip to Abuja: Zuma Rock, Jabi Lake, art galleries, great food, and a sample 4-day itinerary.

## Where to stay: hotel guides

- [Where to Stay: Compare Hotel Rates by City](https://www.karibucongo.com/hotels/): We check Booking.com, Agoda, and more so you get the best rate — free cancellation on most stays.
- [Where to Stay in Abu Dhabi](https://www.karibucongo.com/hotels/where-to-stay-in-abu-dhabi/): Where to stay in Abu Dhabi: the city is more spread out than Dubai, with top sights on separate islands, so your base depends on which side you want.
- [Where to Stay in Kinshasa](https://www.karibucongo.com/hotels/where-to-stay-in-kinshasa/): Where to stay in Kinshasa: the city is huge and runs along the Congo River, so your base shapes how easily you get around and reach nightlife and river life.
- [Where to Stay in Kuala Lumpur](https://www.karibucongo.com/hotels/where-to-stay-in-kuala-lumpur/): Where to stay in Kuala Lumpur: a rainforest-fringed skyline, great food and night markets nearby. Choose by how central and polished you want your base to be.
- [Where to Stay in Mauritius](https://www.karibucongo.com/hotels/where-to-stay-in-mauritius/): Where to stay in Mauritius: calm lagoons in the west, watersports and reef breaks in the north, and a wilder, less developed south. Compare the coasts.
- [Where to Stay in New York](https://www.karibucongo.com/hotels/where-to-stay-in-new-york/): Where to stay in New York: Broadway and Midtown energy, cool downtown, or a quieter base with a short subway ride to everything. Find the right area.
- [Where to Stay in Paris](https://www.karibucongo.com/hotels/where-to-stay-in-paris/): Where to stay in Paris: the city is compact and walkable, but each arrondissement feels different, from grand and touristy to quiet and local.
- [Where to Stay in Seychelles](https://www.karibucongo.com/hotels/where-to-stay-in-seychelles/): Where to stay in Seychelles: choose between Mahé, Praslin and La Digue, each with its own pace, and see how most longer trips combine at least two islands.
- [Where to Stay in Singapore](https://www.karibucongo.com/hotels/where-to-stay-in-singapore/): Singapore is compact and its transit system is excellent, so almost anywhere works logistically — the real question is which vibe you want as your base.
- [Where to Stay in Doha](https://www.karibucongo.com/hotels/where-to-stay-in-doha/): Where to stay in Doha: West Bay and the Corniche, The Pearl-Qatar, Souq Waqif, Katara and Lusail, plus the best base for a short stopover.
- [Where to Stay in Abidjan](https://www.karibucongo.com/hotels/where-to-stay-in-abidjan/): Where to stay in Abidjan: the Plateau business district, lagoon-side Cocody, Grand-Bassam for a beach break, and where to base yourself for early flights.
